errors.text: The proposed material and intervention do not reconstruct the target: they replace HPHT treatment of lamellar Al0.7CoCrFeNi at 6 GPa and 1473 K with nanoprecipitation processing of a tungsten-based refractory alloy.
No concrete SCCP processing temperatures, times, deformation steps, or cooling rates are specified, so the intervention itself is not reproducible from the hypothesis.
The cited excerpts support the SCCP concept and reported properties but do not establish the proposed comparison against standard aging or the detailed processing route described.
